subject: psychology

items.q: Are mental disorders simply a lack of willpower?
items.correct: No — they have biological, cognitive and environmental causes.
items.misconception: Yes, they are just a personal choice or weakness.
items.why: Disorders are complex and treatable (e.g. CBT, medication); they aren't a matter of willpower.

items.q: Can psychological disorders be treated effectively?
items.correct: Yes — therapies like CBT and other treatments are effective.
items.why: Evidence-based treatments (CBT, exposure, medication) help many conditions.
